business_problem: National Healthcare Group needed to modernize a transaction-heavy HR system that lacked mobile access, limited decision-ready data, and made it harder for staff and managers to complete HR tasks efficiently across a large public-health workforce.
solution_summary: IBM, SAP, and Synapxe rebuilt NHG's HR experience as iConnect@NHG in two phases. The first phase established a cloud-based HR backbone on SAP SuccessFactors, standardized end-to-end HR processes across NHG institutions, and made the platform the single source of truth for employee data. SAP Workzone then provided self-service workspaces where staff could retrieve forms, submit claims, and track skills from mobile devices, while IBM Process Taxonomy and Envision Studio were used to redesign workflows and align stakeholders. In phase two, NHG added analytics and talent-management functions, including SAP Analytic Cloud dashboards for leaders and deeper integration across the HR ecosystem. The result is not just a refreshed HRIS but a connected operating layer for workforce processes, analytics, and collaboration that reaches staff inside hospitals and in community settings.

data_flow: Employee HR transactions and profile data flow into SAP SuccessFactors, self-service interactions are exposed through SAP Workzone and the mobile app, and the unified data then feeds SAP Analytic Cloud dashboards so leaders can monitor workforce metrics and make better decisions.
business_outcome: NHG achieved broad workforce adoption of its new HR platform, reduced administrative overhead, improved data accuracy and collaboration, and gave employees mobile access to HR processes so they could spend more time on patient care.
